data.report: Thursday, November 26, 2026 6:15 AM – Happy Thanksgiving from the mountain! A soft gray sky, light winds and mild temperatures are setting up a mellow morning to earn that turkey dinner. 19 lifts are expected to spin today, conditions permitting. Snowmobile Adventures have kicked off for the season, adding another way to get out and play this Thanksgiving week. Expect packed powder and groomed runs that will soften as the day goes on. Keep in mind that early-season obstacles are still present in some areas, so ski and ride with caution. For smooth morning carves, Solitude off High Five Express (5) is a great first stop. Conditions and Visibility: Cloudy skies, light north to northwest winds shifting west this afternoon, and mild temperatures in the 40s. Expect packed powder and groomed corduroy, with firmer conditions early that should soften throughout the day. Flat light is possible under the cloud cover, so a low-light lens is a smart pick. Lift Status: 19 lifts are expected to spin today, conditions permitting. Safety: Be aware of early-season obstacles that may still be hidden beneath the snow. Conditions aren't quite like peak season just yet, so stick to open, groomed trails and ride within your ability level . Check, Don't Wreck. Look uphill and yield to others before starting downhill or merging onto a trail. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort at this time . Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is 760.934.0611. Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches, especially in shaded areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest updates.

Friday, November 27, 2026 6:15 AM – Mostly cloudy skies will stick around today, with a light west-southwest breeze, temperatures in the 40s and slightly stronger winds across the upper mountain this afternoon. 19 lifts are expected to spin today, conditions permitting. Expect packed powder and groomed corduroy, with firmer turns early that will soften as temperatures warm throughout the day. Once the snow loosens up, Saddle Bowl off Face Lift Express (3) is a soft, scenic groomer worth a few laps. Keep in mind that early-season obstacles are still present in some areas, so ski and ride with caution. Tonight, the Holiday Tree Lighting brings Woolly, Santa, live music and kids' activities to The Village from 6 PM to 8:30 PM.
